parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the cluster.

Call [ListClusters](~~87116~~) to obtain the cluster ID.

parameters.name: Instance
parameters.description: Information about the nodes to reset.

sub_parameters.name: Id
sub_parameters.description:
The ID of the Nth compute node to reset. N can be an integer from 1 to 100.

Call [ListNodes](~~87161~~) to obtain the node ID.
